python-fixture-source.name: Python canonical C# fixture source
python-fixture-source.purpose: Selects the reviewed macOS-aware fixture used by Python and ROS conformance

python-fixture-digest.name: Python canonical fixture digest
python-fixture-digest.purpose: Rejects a fixture whose bytes differ from the configured canonical source

unity-fixture-source.name: Unity canonical C# fixture source
unity-fixture-source.purpose: Selects Unity's reviewed canonical fixture independently of Python's fixture revision

unity-fixture-digest.name: Unity canonical fixture Git blob digest
unity-fixture-digest.purpose: Identifies immutable fixture blob bytes independently of checkout line endings

python-receipt-contract.name: Python and ROS Core receipt verifier
python-receipt-contract.purpose: Fixes the executable Core contract used by the inspected receiver workflows; later Core policy does not automatically update this checkout

python-application-receipt-tools.name: Python CLI and ROS shared receipt tools
python-application-receipt-tools.purpose: Fixes the Python validator implementation checked out by application receipt workflows

matlab-receipt-contract.name: MATLAB Core receipt verifier
matlab-receipt-contract.purpose: Fixes the Core contract inspected in the MATLAB receipt workflows; newer policy requires a separate reviewed receiver update

matlab-application-receipt-tools.name: MATLAB CLI shared receipt tools
matlab-application-receipt-tools.purpose: Fixes the MATLAB wrapper validator implementation used by the application receipt workflow
